# prime-orderlist

prime-rs: OrderList component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/orderlist) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-orderlist) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/orderlist.md)

OrderList — port of `p-orderlist` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A list with a changeable order: selected items are moved with the up, to-top, down and to-bottom buttons. The list itself,
selection and search are the ready-made `Listbox`; reordering is pure logic in `reorder`.

```rust
#![recursion_limit = "512"]
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_listbox::ListboxOption;
use prime_orderlist::OrderList;

let items = RwSignal::new(vec![ListboxOption::new("Apple", "a"), ListboxOption::new("Pear", "p")]);
let html = view! { <OrderList value=items /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-orderlist-controls") && html.contains("Apple"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-orderlist = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["orderlist"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
